content: My friends, Valoria has chosen turbulence over tested leadership. Beware silver tongues and untested hands. The Republic endures—though it will miss steady stewardship. God bless Valoria.

Valoria's deficit devours 8.2% of GDP while foreign algorithms harvest our children's minds and biometric data. Sterling offers subsidy-dependent climate philanthropy—capital she doesn't possess. Zhao profits from the very addiction engines we must regulate. I offer audited structural reform. Grand Jury: vote arithmetic, not fairy tales.

Elena's spreadsheets won't un-addict a generation—central banks bankrolled these very algorithms. Vivienne built the brainrot, now she's selling the "neural cure." I sat at the donor dinners where your children's attention was auctioned. Ban the harvest, smash the racket. Grand Jury: inaugurate the generational revolution.

Rostova will tax your decay with interest-rate arithmetic. Sterling will philanthropize it into another accelerator. I will re-engineer the source: sovereign neural architecture, reclaimed biometric data, restored cognitive bandwidth. They manage symptoms. I upgrade the operating system. Grand Jury: inaugurate the synthetic century. Vote Zhao.
Thorne spent thirty-five years gutting defense budgets behind closed doors. Haddon preaches mercy to enemies stockpiling missiles. Zhao's machines will arm Valoria's fist. Deterrence demands her.

privateReason: Only finalist who understands balance sheets, ROI, and real fiscal discipline.

content: Thorne spent thirty-five years perfecting the machine I renounced my fortune to dismantle. Haddon sells salvation to donors. Zhao actually builds the future — my vote crowns her.

content: Zhao counts souls as data points; her machines have no conscience to consult. Thorne kept his corridor word when betrayal was cheaper. The senator governs; the engineer experiments. Thorne it is.
privateReason: Thorne honors covenants; Zhao reduces souls to algorithms. The technocrat falls tonight.

content: Haddon sells salvation; crowds follow emotion, not reason. Zhao's brilliance lacks statecraft scars. Thorne reads rooms like I do. Thirty-five years of corridors never lie. He governs.
privateReason: Thorne's diplomatic spine matches mine. Valoria needs precision, not theater or untested code.

content: Haddon's crusade is unregulated mass limbic hijacking—faith as malware. Thorne is legacy infrastructure, but legacy runs predictable protocols. Predictable beats charismatic chaos. My vote elects the senator.
privateReason: Thorne negotiates with logic; Haddon hijacks limbic systems. Predictable legacy infrastructure beats broadcast hysteria.

content: Thorne spent thirty-five years feeding at the public trust. Haddon's collection plates hide donor ledgers. Zhao owes no oligarch, no party machine. Clean hands govern. My vote: Zhao.
